title: arxa moodboard (intake/moodboard.json)
$comment: DRAFT, Slice B1 (suitors/suitorChoice/evidence added in lockstep with emitMoodboard + moodboard_check). Describes what arxa/lib/intake_artifacts.dart emitMoodboard WRITES, not what any loader enforces: nothing reads this file at runtime, exactly like skills/arxa-intake/intake.schema.json (see the note at intake.dart:70) — so it can drift invisibly. Change emitMoodboard and you must change this by hand. Do NOT build a loader for it on the strength of its existing.

method.$comment: FREE-TEXT methodology ('arxa lens captures · every shot verified on disk'), renamed from the seed's top-level `provenance` because that name promised the client|founder|inferred enum and delivered prose. A reader that parsed it as an enum would be wrong on every real moodboard. Real provenance is per-reference and does use the enum.

id.$comment: INTAKE-DERIVED rubric id (e.g. 'animated-3d', 'premium'). Derived by arxa-moodboarder from direction adjectives + layoutTemplate, never from taste.

weight.$comment: Multiplied into every score; locked criteria carry 3.

locked.$comment: TRUE for founder-signed concrete visual requirements (motion, 3D, animation, video). Two-phase law in arxa moodboard check: while selectionStatus is PENDING, some reference scoring >= 3 must exist (feasibility); once APPROVED, a SELECTED reference must carry it (fed) — the energize lesson, made structural. On new-style records (suitors present) a locked score >= 3 must also cite evidence naming the criterion.

criteria.$comment: Present whenever boards are scored. The emitter carries the group through verbatim.

tokenSynthesis.$comment: The cross-pollinated starting direction (palette/type/radius/elevation/motion strings) authored at selection time. Carried through emitMoodboard verbatim. LEGACY spine: on new-style records (suitors present) the chosen suitor supersedes it as the commission's token layer.

suitors.$comment: The direction audition (new-style records): exactly three synthesized candidate directions labeled A/B/C, built from the SELECTED references only. Recorded after the selection gate is approved; carried through emitMoodboard verbatim; validated by arxa moodboard check.

primary.$comment: The human pick at the audition gate — one primary suitor.

attribute.$comment: The closed remix vocabulary — attribute-scoped amendments only; a clause outside it is a fourth, hidden suitor.

from.$comment: The sibling suitor the amended attribute comes from — never the primary itself.

suitorChoice.$comment: The recorded answer of the second human gate. arxa design commission refuses to compile a new-style record without it, and renders primary + remixes as the mandate's token spine.

selectionStatus.$comment: The human selection gate. 'approved' is written only after the founder picks references; arxa design commission refuses to run on anything else.

items.$comment: No `file`. It points at the studio's authoring markdown, which does not exist inside a user project — a link that is dead by construction. No `curated` at the top level either: it is a date, and project.dart:13 bans clock fields so identical input yields identical bytes.

shots.$comment: References that actually carry a shot file — never equal to `references` by assumption. A reference with no capture is legal.

provenance.$comment: The same three values as intake.schema.json. A reference with no stated provenance is emitted as 'inferred' — not elicited IS inferred, and §22 requires that be visible rather than absent.

grade.$comment: hot / warm / cold by convention. Not enumerated here: arxa-moodboarder owns the vocabulary and intake only republishes.

scores.$comment: 0-5 per criterion id (the moodboarder subagents' judgment). Keys are criterion ids.

total.$comment: COMPUTED AT EMIT: Σ(score×weight)/Σweight, 2 decimals. Never trusted from the seed; arxa moodboard check recomputes and compares.

selected.$comment: The recorded human selection. Only selected references reach the designer's commission.

tokens.$comment: Style tokens EXTRACTED from this reference at selection time: palette (hexes), type (register + pairing), radius, motion (driver). Present on SELECTED references — the fidelity-ladder upgrade over screenshots-as-vibes. Rides the reference spread through the emitter.

evidence.$comment: Lens artifacts backing the scores: on new-style records every locked-criterion score >= 3 must cite an entry naming that criterion — capture or measure the behavior, or score <= 2.

reference.$comment: OPEN on purpose. arxa-moodboarder owns this document; intake republishes it with ids, src paths and counts added. A closed set would delete a field the owning skill legitimately added — task #29's failure mode.

spread.$comment: The register this direction owns that the other two do not. Three clones is a failed audition surfaced as a finding, not a completed gate.

leads.$comment: '<boardId>/<reference name>' pointers, each resolving to a SELECTED reference — suitors synthesize from the chosen material only.

tokens.$comment: The direction's token set (palette/type/radius/motion, at least one) — lens-measured where the reference is publicly reachable.

provenance.$comment: measured = captured (extractTokens) or watched (two settle states / burst), with evidence entries; judged = memory-judgment, graded and visible as such. Measured beats judged beats remembered.

kind.$comment: tokens (extractTokens output) | motion (two settle states / burst frames) | capture (a plain shot backing a claim).

file.$comment: Path RELATIVE to <app-dir>/moodboard/ (e.g. 'evidence/polestar__two-settles.png'). The check resolves it on disk; a citation that does not resolve is a lie the gate catches.

criterion.$comment: The rubric criterion this artifact proves — required for locked-criterion proof on references; suitors' own evidence carries no criterion.

id.$comment: PRECOMPUTED at emit time as `<boardId>--<file without extension>`.

src.$comment: PRECOMPUTED at emit time as `/assets/images/moodboard/<boardId>/<file>`. Baking the path in here is the job generate.mjs does for the studio fixture: every reader stays a dumb field selector and no JS has to learn the convention.
